build_example_encoder: build an encoder function that converts dataset examples into tf.train.Example protobufs using a features specification
build_example_decoder: build a decoder function that parses serialized tf.Tensor data back into decoded dataset examples
get_default_features: create a default FeaturesDict with image and class label features for a given number of channels and classes
ThreadpoolExampleWriter: create a threaded writer that asynchronously encodes and writes dataset examples to sharded TFRecord files
ThreadpoolExampleWriter_write: write a dataset example to a specific shard index using the threadpool writer
